title: Wartime vs Peacetime: Ben Horowitz on Leadership
summary:
You set up this whole thing for this high growth environment
and then all of a sudden it's not a high growth environment. And, you know, the norm was you put the cash on the table. So I reach into my wallet and I pull out
and I unfortunately only had $100.
